tasks.ANSWER_INQUIRY: Answer or resolve inquiries: questions from a service user -> usable answer or resolution. Internal employees, partners, consumers and specialist question domains are functionally transferable; sector, recipient role and voice/text channel alone do not make this partial. Shopping questions are questions too. A single specific inquiry type can match one core task; no requirement to cover every FAQ. Pure document extraction, summarization, case administration, transaction execution and manual processing without answering inquiries are NOT this operation.

V21D001.context_for_4: Explicit inquiry overload/repetition plus response capacity/consistency or complex-issue handling, supported in the input; never invent workload reduction to justify 4.

tasks.SUMMARIZE_COMMUNICATION: Summarize business exchanges: email threads/attachments or functionally equivalent meeting/call conversations -> communication summary. Static contract, review or website summaries have a different functional object and are partial, not direct.
tasks.IDENTIFY_FOLLOWUP: Identify next actions from business exchanges -> explicit action items, next steps or follow-up list. Merely summarizing, extracting contact fields or administering an existing case is not identification of next actions.

V21D002.context_for_4: Communication interpretation/summary AND action identification across lengthy business exchanges are explicitly supported.

tasks.RETRIEVE_KNOWLEDGE: Find/retrieve existing internal regulations, manuals, past cases or equivalent organizational knowledge -> retrieved knowledge or evidence-grounded answer. Producing/translating/summarizing new content without discovery of existing knowledge is not this task.
tasks.REUSE_KNOWLEDGE: Find and reuse existing organizational materials instead of recreating them -> reused existing material; not ordinary new drafting.

V21D003.context_for_4: Fragmented knowledge sources and slow discovery/redundant creation explicitly align.

tasks.VERIFY_DOCUMENT: Check documents or equivalent business records against required fields, reference evidence or rules -> validation findings, discrepancies or compliance judgment. Data extraction/classification alone is only a supporting operation. Physical defect detection has a different functional object; generic checking is insufficient.

V21D004.context_for_4: Document variety plus manual checks and missing/error risk are explicitly supported; no inferred regulatory regime.

tasks.INTEGRATE_DATA: Combine data from multiple systems/units -> unified operational dataset or cross-unit overview. Extracting fields from isolated documents alone is only upstream support.
tasks.STANDARDIZE_ANALYSIS: Align inconsistent cross-unit metrics/analysis -> consistent comparative analysis or enterprise overview.

V21D005.context_for_4: Both cross-system/organizational fragmentation and inconsistent analysis/decision overview explicitly align.

tasks.CLASSIFY_PRODUCT: Classify/tag product attributes -> structured catalog attributes or tags; sector can differ but the object must perform a product/catalog role.
tasks.MATCH_PRODUCT_SEARCH: Link customer search intent to product records -> matched products or product locations.
tasks.GUIDE_PRODUCT_DISCOVERY: Answer shopping/project-product questions or guide customer-specific product exploration -> product advice, discovery or recommendations.

V21D006.context_for_4: Multiple explicit catalog onboarding/search/discovery requirements are supported, not merely an e-commerce context.

tasks.COMPARE_REQUIREMENTS: Compare customer drawings/requirements and supplier proposals or functionally equivalent quote/procurement evidence -> comparative feasibility, cost or supplier decision.
tasks.DRAFT_QUOTATION: Create a customer quotation from requirements -> quotation; industry can differ. Extracting source data for an estimator alone is only supporting.
tasks.PROCUREMENT_FOLLOWUP: Perform quote/procurement-linked follow-up -> completed procurement/quotation workflow. General manufacturing scheduling is not procurement follow-up.

V21D007.context_for_4: Requirements comparison, expert decision and quote/procurement workflow are substantially covered with source evidence.

tasks.FORECAST_QUANTITY: Predict future demand, production or functionally equivalent varying operating quantities -> future quantity forecast for planning. Scheduling alone, current defect detection or non-quantity content generation does not match.

V21D008.context_for_4: Future prediction and the varying weather/market/operating-condition planning difficulty explicitly align.

tasks.CONTROL_AI_ACCESS: Restrict sensitive data exposure or securely connect internal data/systems to AI -> protected AI data access/integration. An internal workflow or regulated industry alone is insufficient. Image anonymization without an AI linkage is supporting privacy work, not direct AI integration.
tasks.GOVERN_ENTERPRISE_AI: Apply consistent security/operating controls across enterprise AI tools -> governed AI rollout. Require explicit AI/security/governance evidence; never infer it from banking or document processing.

V21D009.context_for_4: Sensitive-data restriction, protected internal linkage and enterprise AI governance substantially supported.

tasks.INTEGRATE_PRODUCTION_DATA: Integrate fragmented production/quality/equipment or functionally equivalent operational process data -> unified operational data for diagnosis/planning.
tasks.DIAGNOSE_QUALITY_CAUSE: Analyze reasons/drivers/root causes of quality defects -> causal diagnosis. Detecting that a defect is present is supporting inspection, NOT cause diagnosis. Survey theme summarization is not causal diagnosis.
tasks.ADJUST_PRODUCTION_PLAN: Adjust operational production schedules when orders/equipment/constraints change -> revised schedule or validated schedule adjustments. Other sectors can transfer the same constrained scheduling operation. Generic initial planning without adjustment evidence is supporting.

V21D010.context_for_4: Fragmentation, quality-cause diagnosis and changing-condition rescheduling are substantially supported.

V21D001:ANSWER.description: Inquiry answering itself, not any reduction in support work.

V21D002:FOLLOWUP.description: Identifying action items; communication summaries alone are supporting.

V21D010:CAUSE.source_quote: 품질 이상이 발생했을 때 원인을 찾는
V21D010:CAUSE.description: Quality-cause diagnosis only; do not borrow relevance from production scheduling.

label_policy: Keep three complete judge-specific AI Silver sets for primary sensitivity analyses; report unanimous binary consensus separately and leave boundary disagreements unresolved. Never approve by majority. Same retrieval rankings evaluated against each judge and consensus uncertainty bounds; no human Gold claim.
